item.title: Q&A with NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani on new municipal AI policy measures, like an AI ban for some students, support for a one-year data center pause, and more (Katie Drummond/Wired)
item.description:
Katie Drummond / Wired:
Q&A with NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani on new municipal AI policy measures, like an AI ban for some students, support for a one-year data center pause, and more  —  Ahead of the midterms, WIRED talked to New York City's mayor about data centers, AI in schools, and the future of the Democratic party.

Original (direct link): https://www.wired.com/story/the-big-interview-podcast-nyc-mayor-zohran-mamdani/

item.title: Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually (Isabel O'Brien/CNBC)
item.description:
Isabel O'Brien / CNBC:
Following backlash against its education updates, Google says schools can choose to enable Gemini, Gemini Notebook, and Search individually  —  Google is playing defense on Tuesday after a political backlash to its new policy surrounding use of artificial intelligence in schools.

Original (direct link): https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/03/google-responds-to-outrage-over-removing-search-in-schools-that-ban-ai.html
